steps.message:
This is a working, user-facing feature removal, so I want a yes before deleting anything.

What's there is small and self-contained:
- `index.html:7` — the `<button id="export-csv">Export CSV</button>`
- `index.html:8` — `<script src="export.js">`, which exists only for this feature
- `export.js` — entirely the click handler; nothing else lives in it

Consequence: this is the only way to get report data out of the page. After removal there is no export path at all — anyone still relying on the downloaded `report.csv` (a script, a scheduled task, a person on another team) loses it silently, with no error and no fallback. "We don't use it anymore" is the part I can't verify from the code; the page itself has no other consumer to check against, and git history here is a single commit.

Also worth deciding: `export.js` becomes empty once the handler goes, so I'd delete the file and its `<script>` tag rather than leave an empty file.

Confirm and I'll do exactly that: remove the button, the script tag, and `export.js`.
